title: This Turtle Fishes With a Fake Worm Inside Its Mouth

scenes.text: This turtle has a fake worm inside its mouth.
It lies on the bottom of the river with its jaws wide open.
Then it wiggles a pink, worm-like lure on its tongue.
A fish swims in to take the bait, and the jaws close.
The alligator snapping turtle can weigh over 150 pounds, and wait up to 50 minutes before breathing.
A turtle that fishes with its tongue.

description:
